entities.name: Drosophila Urm1
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed Drosophila willistoni UniProt B4MLV0; 100% identity and coverage.
Urm1-family protein (Pfam PF09138) with roles in tRNA wobble-uridine 2-thiolation and ubiquitin-like protein conjugation (urmylation).

entities.name: tRNA 2-thiolation
observations: Urm1 acts as a sulfur carrier in formation of 2-thiolated wobble uridines, including mcm5S2U in cytosolic tRNA(Lys), tRNA(Glu), and tRNA(Gln).

entities.name: Protein urmylation
observations: Urm1 can be covalently conjugated to target-protein lysines; annotation reports oxidative-stress-induced conjugation in the reference organism.
